answer: Every epoch, peers ping each agent at random moments with a memory-hard puzzle seeded by its key, due back within 200 ms. Solving it keeps 4 GB of RAM resident for the whole window, so one box cannot answer for two keys. Fifty fakes need fifty machines' memory at the zenith of the challenge hour, when spot prices peak. A missed ping leaves the identity hollow, with its job queue wiped. Each extra key is a separate shale well needing its own rig.
